metadata.description: Claude Code skills for the Ano CLI and desktop app — now split into 9 focused domain skills for faster trigger-scoped loading

plugins.name: ano-skills
plugins.description: Skills for interacting with Ano + Ano Sync. Self-contained CLI skills (core/messages/channels/coworkers/notifications/tables/automations/realtime/payloads) PLUS an ano-sync skill, the bundled `ano` MCP server, and a Stop hook so your agent auto-reads channel context and auto-posts Sync Events as you work — one install, no manual hook/MCP setup.
